name: Original action adapter: fresh 128 updates and fixed-input diagnostic
body:
# Completed original action-adapter training and its preceding diagnostic

The original 947,712-parameter action adapter completed a fresh 128 paired optimizer updates on the frozen Wan2.2 TI2V5B foundation. Parent time was 388.465 seconds. Independent retained-artifact checks passed for all 825 foundation value identities, 256 training predictions, 128 gradient bundles and all nine retained checkpoints. Checkpoint 128 SHA256: `ac1160b22531804c473746d2fb8ee9edd75710e0e43d6f1eabc86d268c864996`.

This is numerical training evidence on four paired windows from one original room. It does not establish visible door/camera control or generalization. The separate 14-prediction diagnostic in this release compares checkpoints 0 and 16 only; it does not evaluate checkpoint 128. The earlier 16-update rendered pair failed the requested action behavior. No image generation was performed by this training run.

## Combined raw evidence

All 957 original recovery members are retained. Public uncompressed total is 2,096,526,695 bytes; the new gzip-level-1 stream is 1,514,792,115 bytes split into 100 parts: the first 90 are 16,000,000 bytes each and the final 10 are at most 8,000,000 bytes. `index.json` pins every public file and part. Full stream SHA256: `99fab5e86f05fccd2a1f2d9abfcc4f364107ae80a146130d7dd160afd2063e72`. Public index SHA256: `f2fc04946402a67a3179b0245545fa6ddd703872b769a3835d7a7330683f5134`.

`original-index.json` preserves the unchanged original recovery identity: 957 files / 2,096,526,751 bytes, original compressed stream `7e6b1d440753726627c1139487d458315a1b5c9c9996714bfe4896af5874f045`. Exactly two local workspace prefixes in one historical missing-pytest traceback are replaced by `[WORKSPACE]/` in the public archive. All other 956 files are byte-identical, including every model/runtime/protocol/source/metric/tensor file. No failure evidence or member is discarded. `public-derivation.json` records original/public hashes, the exact replacement rule and prefix hash, and the different stream identity. The original archive remains unchanged locally.

The independent audit asset also replaces the one private workspace prefix in its operational `run` field. `audit-path-derivation.json` records both audit hashes and the exact change; every numerical and identity field remains unchanged. The original audit SHA256 is `e987d7b31ce754977ce8ee547aa9e2cf4a2b31afc136a4f57b893de6950caa7b`.

The completed runs are `recovered/action-results/diagnostic-spatial-v3` and `recovered/action-results/fixed128-spatial-v1`. Final weights are `training/checkpoint-0128/adapter.safetensors`. Original checkpoint-zero initialization, the first 16 saved draws, the remaining 112 saved draws, all retained optimizer/RNG states, cache/probe inputs, exact sources and failure history are included. The intermediate diagnostic-only transport is not duplicated as another asset.

Download `fetch_artifacts.py` and `release-download.json`, then run:

```sh
python3 fetch_artifacts.py --metadata release-download.json --output /absolute/fresh-recovery
```

The unchanged bounded downloader verifies the public HTTPS metadata, index, every ordered part, the combined stream and all extracted files. TLS verification stays enabled. Its historical module description mentions the previous fixed16 release; the supplied metadata selects this exact combined release. No provider account, credentials, model weights or model execution is needed. The included local recovery record verified all 957 public files before upload; publication proceeds only after all remote sizes and SHA256 digests agree.

## Source and licenses

Executed dependency source is repository commit `099eeae6268da852b0acb580258e4c168f900520`, with the exact original local fixed128/diagnostic programs in the archive. The release target commit is publication context, not a claim that the work-only programs were already tracked there. The original source/input packet remains available in the earlier `wan22-action-cuda-a100-v1` release; this complete recovery retains the measured source map and copies needed for these runs.

Original Worldline code and adapter weights use Apache-2.0. External Wan foundation/VAE/source retain their Apache-2.0 license and NOTICE. Original procedural Atrium images and metadata use CC0. Those license files are separate assets and retained in their relevant source/input directories. No external foundation weight checkpoint, installed environment or provider credential is included. No new architecture novelty or frontier-model parity is claimed.

The earlier verified 45 MB transport failed during upload. The same gzip stream was then split into 95 parts at most 16 MB; `public-index-45mb.json` and `public-download-45mb.json` retain the previous public transport pins. No raw member changed during repartitioning.

After the first 90 parts uploaded successfully, part 090 failed both bounded 16 MB attempts. Only the unuploaded tail was repartitioned into 10 parts at most 8 MB. `public-index-16mb.json`, `public-download-16mb.json` and `README-16mb-attempt.md` preserve the previous layout. The final index contains 100 parts; every original scientific byte and the public gzip stream remain unchanged.
